app.name: Falco
app.tagline: Play with friends. Fast as a falcon.

friends.title: Friends
friends.emptyTitle: Your friends will show up here
friends.emptyBody: Send them an invite on Discord or WhatsApp: one click from them, two from you, and you're ready to play.

confirm.remove: Remove {name}? They won't be able to connect and their device will be unpaired.
confirm.block: Block {name}? You won't see them and they can't reach you. You can unblock them in settings.

activity.playing: Playing · no free seats | Playing · {n} free seat | Playing · {n} free seats

host.title: Host
host.availableHint: Friends can see you and ask to join. When you're not available, the streaming engine is off.

state.starting: Starting the engine… the first time takes about half a minute

host.noRequests: No requests. When a friend presses “Pair”, it shows up here.
host.heroOnBody: Nobody connected: invite someone or wait for a knock. | One person connected. | {n} people connected.
host.heroOffBody: Friends can join and, by default, only watch. You decide who can use keyboard, mouse and controller.

invites.title: Invites
invites.emptyBody: Invites you create show up here, with uses left and expiry. You can revoke them any time.
invites.usesLeft: no uses left | 1 use left | {n} uses left

settings.title: Settings
settings.license: Free software under the GPL-3.0 license.

oauth.title: Automatic invites with Tailscale
oauth.intro: To create invites in one click, create an OAuth client in the Tailscale console (Settings → Trust credentials) with the scopes devices:core:read and device_invites, then paste its ID and secret here. You only do this once.
oauth.configured: Set up: invites include Tailscale sharing.
oauth.saved: Credentials verified and saved in the keychain.

settings.permissionsIntro: Role given to new friends and join rules. Each friend's permissions are changed from their panel.
settings.headscaleLogin: Sign in to the Headscale server
settings.headscaleStarted: Sign-in started: finish it in your browser.

action.installTailscale: Install Tailscale from the official site, then reopen Falco.
action.loginTailscale: Sign in to Tailscale with Google, Microsoft or GitHub.
action.disableExitNode: Turn off the exit node while playing: it adds latency.
action.enableUpnp: Enable UPnP on your router, or forward UDP port 41641 to the host PC.
action.unblockUdp: UDP traffic seems blocked: check your firewall or router, or try another network.
action.friendOffline: Your friend isn't answering: ask them to open Falco.
action.hostOff: Turn on “Available” to test the streaming ports.
action.firewall: The firewall is blocking streaming: allow Falco in your firewall settings.
action.lowBandwidth: Low bandwidth: stop downloads and other streams or lower the quality.
action.unstableLine: Unstable line: use a cable or move closer to the router.
action.needFriend: A friend needs to be online to measure this.
action.useCable: You're on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi: use a cable or the 5/6 GHz network.
action.cableBetter: Fine, but a cable is steadier for gaming.
action.plugIn: The laptop is on battery: plug it in for the best performance.
action.highPerformance: Power saver is on: switch to “balanced” or “high performance”.
action.disableVpn: Another VPN can add latency: turn it off while playing.
action.playOnce: Play one session: Falco measures the real latency.
action.framesDropped: Dropped frames: use a cable, stop downloads and streams, or lower the bitrate.
action.networkLatency: Slow network to the host: check the path is direct and not via relay.
action.hostLatency: The host takes too long to encode: lower resolution or fps, or close heavy apps on the host.
action.clientLatency: Your PC takes too long to show frames: use full screen and keep V-Sync off.

core.offlineWhy: The background service seems to be closed.
core.offlineFix: Reopen it from the Start menu or Launchpad: this window reconnects on its own.

errors.cannotJoin: I can't join {name}. {why}. Try again shortly or ask if they're still available.
errors.generic: Something didn't work. The technical reason is: “{why}”. Try again; if it happens again press “Debug” and copy the details.
errors.session: The session didn't start. Reason: “{why}”. Check that the host is still available and try again.
errors.hostNotReady: Hosting isn't active. The streaming engine is off. Turn on “Available to friends” in Host and try again.
errors.config: Invalid setting: “{key}”. The value is out of range. Allowed values: {allowed}.
errors.invalidParams: Invalid request. Falco received unexpected data ({why}). Try again; if it happens again open “Debug”.
errors.unknownMethod: Feature not available. The Falco service is a different version from the window. Restart Falco.

background.host_start: I can't start hosting. Reason: “{why}”. Close other streaming apps using the same ports, then try again.
background.session_pair: Pairing with the host failed. Reason: “{why}”. Check the host is online and the PIN is right, then try again.
background.session: The session was interrupted. Reason: “{why}”. Check your connection and rejoin; if it happens often open the Network doctor.
background.update_install: Update failed. Reason: “{why}”. Falco stays on the current version: try again from Settings → About.
background.invite_accept: Invite not accepted. Reason: “{why}”. Ask for a new invite or try again shortly.

connect.title: Direct connection
connect.hint: Connect to a host by address (Tailscale or local network), without an invite. Handy for tests and special networks.
connect.pinPrompt: Ask the host to enter this PIN:
connect.paired: Paired with {host}. You can join now.
connect.pairFailed: Pairing failed. The PIN may be wrong: try again.
connect.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again shortly.

hint.spettatore: Sees and hears the stream, no input
hint.fidato: Everything, including launching apps and ending the session

perm.gamepads: no controllers | One controller | Up to {n} controllers

invite.title: Invite a friend
invite.approvalNote: With more than one use you'll approve each join.
invite.share: Paste the link on Discord or WhatsApp. If the chat doesn't make it clickable, your friend just copies it: Falco finds it in the clipboard.
invite.secret: Anyone with the link can use it: only send it to the right friend.
invite.noShare: Tailscale isn't set up for invites: your friend must already be in your network. Set it up in Settings → Host.

accept.title: Accept invite
accept.invalid: This link doesn't look like a Falco invite.
accept.browserNote: Your browser will open to confirm sharing on Tailscale: it takes one click.
accept.doneBody: You and {name} are friends. When they host, you'll find them in “Playing now”.
accept.clipboard: You have an invite from {name} in your clipboard

onboarding.intro: Stream games with your friends, as if they were on the couch next to you. You need a name and, if you like, a picture.
onboarding.name: Name
onboarding.nameHint: 2 to 24 characters. You can change it any time.

tailscale.needsLogin: Tailscale is installed but you need to sign in. You'll do it with your first invite.
tailscale.stopped: Tailscale is off: open it before inviting someone.
tailscale.missing: Tailscale isn't there yet: Falco installs it for you in one click.

perms.title: Permissions
perms.enforced: Access, schedule and expiry are enforced by your host. Controller, keyboard and mouse filtering arrives with the Falco engine.
perms.notPaired: Your friend's device isn't paired with your host yet: permissions apply from the first connection.

joinError.not-hosting: {name} isn't hosting. They ended the session or aren't available anymore. Try again when you see them in “Playing now”.
joinError.no-access: You can't join {name}. Your role doesn't allow access. Ask them to change it.
joinError.schedule: You can't join {name} right now. You're outside the time window they gave you. Try again later.
joinError.full: {name}'s session is full. All seats are taken. Try again when one frees up.
joinError.no-answer: {name} didn't answer. Maybe they didn't see the request. Try again or message them.
joinError.declined: {name} declined the request. It's not a good time. Try again later.
joinError.unknown: {name} doesn't recognise you as a friend. The friendship may have been removed. Ask for a new invite.
joinError.offline: I can't reach {name}. Their Falco or Tailscale seems to be off. Ask them to open Falco.

general.close_to_tray: Closing the window keeps it in the tray

performance.warn_on_battery: Warn when the laptop is on battery

update.disabled: Automatic updates turn on once the first version is published on GitHub.

debug.title: Error details
debug.intro: Everything needed to understand what happened. No secrets: no keys, passwords or invite links. Copy and paste it wherever you ask for help.
debug.loading: Collecting information from the Falco service…
debug.coreUnavailable: The Falco service isn't answering, so its details are missing: {why}

bar.label: Actions and stream
bar.waiting: Waiting for friends · invite someone to start
bar.idle: Share your screen so friends can join, or join someone who's playing

guests.label: Connected people
guests.pending: Devices changed: they apply from the next connection.

session.yourDevices: What you can use in this session
session.externalTitle: The stream is in its own window
session.externalBody: On this system the stream opens in its own window. Actions stay down here.
session.tip: Click the stream to use mouse and keyboard, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Z to release them

share.title: Sharing quality
share.subtitle: Choose how your screen is sent to friends. Try them all: they switch instantly when nobody is connected.
share.appliesLater: Saved: applies the next time sharing starts (someone is connected now).
share.appliedNow: Applied: sharing restarted with the new settings.
share.testingBody: Measuring bandwidth and stability towards your friends: it takes a few seconds.
share.alreadyBest: You're already using the best one
share.capHint: Cap for every guest. Lower it if your upload is slow.
share.fecHint: Higher survives packet loss better, but uses more bandwidth.

latency.name: Low latency
latency.desc: The lowest possible delay. For fast games on a good network.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.desc: A touch more delay, copes better with Wi‑Fi and uneven networks.

slow.name: Slow connection
slow.desc: Caps bandwidth and guards against loss. For slow networks or relays.

quality.name: Best quality
quality.desc: More detail for the same bandwidth, a few milliseconds more.

custom.name: Custom
custom.desc: Pick maximum bitrate, error correction and encoder yourself.

reasons.relay: At least one friend goes through a relay: better cap the bandwidth.
reasons.lowBandwidth: Bandwidth to your friends is low (under 20 Mbps).
reasons.mediumBandwidth: Bandwidth to your friends is moderate (under 40 Mbps).
reasons.jitter: The network is a bit uneven: more error correction helps.
reasons.wifi: You're on Wi‑Fi: a cable cuts delay and loss.
reasons.framesDropped: Frames were lost in the last session.
reasons.noFriend: No reachable friend to measure: keeping the most responsive profile.
reasons.fastNetwork: Fast, steady network: you can use the lowest latency.
